node.name: старословенски

node.note: The PERSJ стсл. concept denotes the ninth–eleventh-century language; it requires a registered-base private-use stage tag because ISO 639 and Glottolog intentionally collapse it with later Church Slavonic.

node.name: црквенословенски

node.note: The PERSJ цсл. concept denotes the post-eleventh-century phase and is the parent of national recensions; it is broader-aligned to the standards umbrella node.
